'''Pral''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Jahilid Drift]] that was [[Subjugation of Pral|conquered]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Bentilais san Sk'ar]].<ref name="Hyperspace" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pral was first mentioned in "[[Aliens in the Empire]], Part 2: To a Traitor Go the Spoils," a [[2007]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] article written by [[Abel G. Peña]] and [[Rich Handley]].<ref name="Hyperspace" /> Although the [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' placed Pral within the Jahilid Drift, which was stated to be an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region,<ref name="CSWE" /> the [[2009]] book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Pral system, and therefore Pral itself, in grid square L-21 as part of Wild [[Realspace/Legends|Space]] instead.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Jason Fry, co-author of ''The Essential Atlas'', confirmed during the development of the [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]] that the Wild Space localization prevails.<ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC_discussion_2023_2.jpg|creator=[[Jason Fry]]|date=2023-04-06}}</ref>
